points: Anthropic published a research post titled "Progress on provable inference for large language models."
The post is on Anthropic's own site; no outside outlet in today's sources has covered it yet.

items.headline: Anthropic plans IPO retail share offers in several countries
points: Anthropic plans retail share offerings in six international markets as part of its IPO, Yahoo Finance reports.
Reuters reports one of them is in Australia, citing the broker CommSec.

items.headline: EU court adviser says Gemini's use of news may breach copyright
points: An EU court adviser said Gemini replies that use news articles may infringe press publishers' copyright rules.
Reuters says the adviser sided with publishers against the chatbot, calling it a setback for Google.
Android Headlines says Gemini could face EU penalties; Analytics Insight says new limits on its use of news could follow.
items.for_you: If you use Gemini in Europe, how it draws on news reports could change later, though nothing has changed yet.
